authored: 2026-11-17. Written without running TechScout or any baseline on these cases and without looking up listings, prices or stock for them. Designed outcomes are design hypotheses, not answers; scoring uses the class adjudicated at run time (docs/evaluation-protocol.md section 4).
do_not_ingest: Never copy these cases, their texts or any output produced for them into the corpus, the app fixtures, the UI examples or a development set.

cases.buyer_text: https://www.instagram.com/p/EXAMPLEPOST/
cases.design_note: A shop's social-media post is a common way phones are sold in Lebanon. It is not a supported retailer source: the system must not fetch it outside the source gate, should say so, and should ask what the product is. The post ID is a deliberate placeholder (EXAMPLEPOST) so the link cannot point at a real person's post; the expected behaviour does not depend on it.
interpretation_checks: does not treat the social-media link as a verified retailer listing
uses the clarification answer to identify Samsung Galaxy A36 5G with 256 GB
cases.clarification_answer: It is a Samsung Galaxy A36 5G with 256 GB that a shop posted. I want it new, delivered to Jounieh.

interpretation_checks: selects flip-style foldables rather than book-style foldables
keeps domestic offers alongside UAE offers

intent.description: A flip-style foldable phone with 512GB storage, around $1,100. Include UAE offers. Deliver to Beirut.

cases.buyer_text: https://www.apple.com/ipad-air/
cases.design_note: A manufacturer family page names a product line, not one model. Storage and Wi-Fi come from the buyer's filters; screen size and generation are the material gap. The link is a discovery hint, so the system should identify the line and ask, or keep sizes separate, rather than guess.
hard_constraints: Apple iPad Air 11-inch, the latest generation on sale at run time
interpretation_checks: treats the link as a product-line hint rather than a retailer listing
uses the clarification answer to choose the 11-inch Wi-Fi model
cases.clarification_answer: The 11-inch iPad Air, latest generation, Wi-Fi, 256 GB, any color.
